d: Bihar men dhanteras aur dipavli ko lekar is sal vyaparik gatividhiyon men aitihasik uchhal dekhne ko mil raha hai. konphedreshan oph ol indiya tredars (CAIT) ke pradesh adhyaksh ashok kumar varma ke anusar, tyoharon ke dauran pure bihar men lagbhag 5,000 karor rupye ke vyapar ka anuman hai, jo pichhle varshon ki tulna men lagbhag dhaee guna adhik hai. akele patna ki bat karen to sarrapha bajar men 700 se 800 karor rupye, ilektroniks bajar men 500 karor rupye se adhik aur bartan va redimed kapron ke bajar men rikord bikri ki sanbhavna jataee gaee hai. dukandaron ka manna hai ki dipavli ke…
